enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Remain motionless. Turn to one side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Shift legs. Turn to other side. Remain asleep. Eyes remain closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and cereal. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Wash bowl and spoon.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out work clothes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on work clothes. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Put stethoscope in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up backpack. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust rearview mirror. Drive. Stop at red light. Continue driving. Park car in hospital parking lot. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working clinical shift at the hospital, caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes in chart. Walk to nurses' station. Discuss with colleague. Pick up next chart. Walk to next patient room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short lunch break in the staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Throw away trash. Stand up. Walk out of staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties and patient care at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Return to nurses' station. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Check blood pressure. Change bandage. Talk to patient. Record notes. Walk to supply room. Restock gloves. Walk to next patient. Administer injection. Update chart. Walk to break room. Drink water. Return to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home as the storm approaches
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Turn on headlights. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Lock car. Walk to front door. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place in drying rack. Drain sink. Wipe counter with cloth. Throw away trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking storm updates, closing windows and charging phone in case of a power outage
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Watch news. Stand up. Close window. Lock window. Close second window. Lock second window. Pick up phone. Plug phone into charger. Sit on couch.

Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select movie. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and reading on the phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Scroll through articles. Read. Turn off desk lamp. Put down phone. Lie down on bed.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Remain motionless. Turn to one side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Shift legs. Turn to other side. Remain asleep. Eyes remain closed.
